display.title: Episode 455: The Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: A first-grade class celebrates finishing the Alef-Beis, and in chapter 2 of the Ten Wedding Gifts a mysterious rabbi and ten students arrive at the orphans' wedding.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi joins a first-grade class from Beis Yaakov of Boro Park celebrating their Siyum HaAlef-Beis. He explains why Hebrew is Lashon HaKodesh: other languages were made by people, but Hashem created the world with Hebrew words and gave the Torah in it. The siddur is like a telephone: say the words clearly and correctly and your call always gets through. The girls sing a special song about greeting the siddur, and their teacher thanks Uncle Yossi. After the Hakochainik march, the class recites the Shema and everyone gives tzedakah. In chapter 2 of 'The Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts', Reuven praises Avraham and Sarah for freeing the captive, pays for their wedding clothes again, and invites the whole town to the wedding. A holy-looking rabbi arrives with ten students, is honored with the brachos under the chuppah, and finally reveals that he is the Baal Shem Tov, sent by the Heavenly Court to bless them. To be continued. The show ends with candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Hebrew is Hashem's holy language, so say the words of the siddur clearly; and kindness to others is noticed in Heaven.
